title.narrative: Fourniture d'une assistance alimentaire et nutritionnelle et renforcement des activités génératrices de revenus pour atténuer l''impact négatif de El Nino sur les populations à risque à Madagascar

description.narrative: The main objective of this project is to provide food and nutritional assistance to vulnerable at-risk populations in Madagascar to mitigate the negative impact of El Nino. This WFP project provides food assistance, improved coverage of nutritional supplementation for children suffering from moderate acute malnutrition, and screening and early detection interventions to combat acute malnutrition in children. The project provides life-saving assistance to 58,333 people, including 8,000 women, 6,500 men, 43,833 children, and 1,833 persons with disabilities.
